personas.name: Non-Muslim curious
personas.description: You want to experience Ramadan fasting and learn about the culture without religious obligation. TryRamadan tailors content for learning and wellness.

journey.description: Land on TryRamadan, read about fasting like a Muslim for the holy month.
Complete onboarding: choose Non-Muslim mode, knowledge check, health screening, location, schedule, priorities, and goals.
Use the dashboard: countdown, I'm fasting / Break fast, today's plan, Learn, Culture, Recipes.
Explore guides, glossary, hadith, culture by country, and health & safety when needed.

personas.name: Muslim observer
personas.description: You observe Ramadan and want prayer times, fasting tracking, Quran, and spiritual content in one place. TryRamadan supports full observance.

journey.description: Land on TryRamadan or open the app for the holy month.
Complete onboarding: choose Muslim mode, knowledge check, health, location for accurate prayer times, schedule, notifications, priorities (Quran/glossary), goals.
Dashboard: countdown to iftar, I'm fasting / Break fast, prayer times, Quran, Glossary, today's plan, progress.
Prayers page, Quran reading plan, hadith, culture, and emergency break-fast if needed.

personas.name: Health & wellness focus
personas.description: You're interested in intermittent fasting, nutrition, and wellness during Ramadan. TryRamadan offers macro tracking, hydration, and health checks.

journey.description: Find TryRamadan for a structured fasting experience with health in mind.
Onboarding: health screening first, then location, schedule, priorities (enable macro tracking if you want), goals.
Dashboard and Today: fasting timer, hydration, energy check-in, macro tracker, meals and recipes.
Schedule page for food log and macros; Health page for wellness and symptoms; Programs for progressive fasting.

personas.name: Culture & food explorer
personas.description: You want to explore Ramadan through food and traditions from different countries. TryRamadan surfaces recipes and culture by region.

journey.description: Land on TryRamadan to experience Ramadan through culture and food.
Onboarding: set priorities to Culture & recipes (some or lots), then location, schedule, goals.
Dashboard quick access to Culture and Meals; today's plan for suhoor/iftar notes.
Culture by country, recipes by region, and traditions. Add recipes to meal plan.

personas.name: Quran & learning focus
personas.description: You want to read the Quran during Ramadan and learn Islamic terms and hadith. TryRamadan prioritizes Quran, glossary, and learning.

journey.description: Open TryRamadan for Quran and learning during the holy month.
Onboarding: Muslim mode, priorities set Quran to Some or Daily, Glossary and Learn high. Location for prayer times.
Dashboard quick access: Quran, Glossary, Learn. Countdown to iftar, prayer times.
Quran juz plan, glossary for terms, hadith, and daily facts.
